The '''Combined Operations Center''' or '''ComOps Center''' for [[Outbound Flight]] was located on [[Dreadnaught-One]]. From this area, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pakmillu]] had control over all six [[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnaughts]]. Located just behind the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]/[[Computer monitor/Legends|monitor]] room complex, the ComOps Center stretched for thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] between the two main bow corridors. All 200 single-seat [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] used for transportation around Outbound Flight could be controlled from this point. In addition, the ComOps Center was where [[Lorana/Legends|Lorana]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], single-handedly controlled all six Dreadnaughts of the severely damaged Outbound Flight Project and landed them in a rock-filled valley on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] without severely hurting any of the 57 remaining passengers of Outbound Flight. In the process, however, both Lorana and [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Thrass]] gave their lives to save the passengers.<ref name="OBF" />
